paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: This figure compares the error rate (one average minus test accuracy), computation cost, and GPU memory across our approach and baselines, for fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks with QAdapter.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates GPU memory usage for different adapter methods. The horizontal axis represents the method name, labeled as “Full FT”, “MTL-FT”, “TAG”, “QAdapter”, “Adapter”, and “Ours”, displayed in a non-alphabetical order. The vertical axis is labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” and represents memory usage in gigabytes, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, and tick labels at 0, 20, 40, and 60.  There are six individual bars, all colored either orange or green. “Full FT” is represented by an orange bar with an approximate height of 61 GB, while “MTL-FT” is represented by an orange bar with a height of approximately 44 GB. “TAG” demonstrates an orange bar of around 21 GB in height, followed by a yellow “QAdapter” bar about 12 GB tall.  “Adapter” has a yellow bar with around 9 GB, and finally, “Ours” is indicated by a green bar measuring approximately 16 GB in height. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
